title: About This Site
description: About PBZero Wiki - an independent, fan-run guide covering bosses, weapons, characters, and story for Phantom Blade Zero.

sections.title: What Is PBZero Wiki?
sections.content:
PBZero Wiki is an independent, fan-run guide site dedicated to Phantom Blade Zero, the martial arts action RPG from S-Game. We collect and organize everything revealed about the game — bosses, weapons, characters, and story — into clear, readable guides.

Our goal is simple: give players and newcomers accurate information without fluff or clickbait.

sections.title: What We Cover
sections.content:
• Boss Guides — every confirmed boss with strategies and how to prepare
  • Weapons — the Shachi system explained, weapon categories, and build synergy
  • Characters — all playable characters and key NPCs
  • Protagonist — Soul's backstory, the 66-day curse, and combat style
  • Game Info — developer, platforms, release date, and series history

sections.title: Our Editorial Approach
sections.content:
Because Phantom Blade Zero has not yet launched, our guides are built from official demos, trailers, developer interviews, and press coverage. We clearly mark which information is demo-verified and which is still unconfirmed.

Once the game releases, we update our guides with hands-on testing. We do not copy content from other sites.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.content:
PBZero Wiki is an unofficial fan site. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by S-Game (北京灵游坊科技).

Phantom Blade Zero and all related names, marks, and imagery are the property of their respective owners.
